environment.description: Same application container deployed to ECS Fargate behind ALB. CloudFront distribution in front with origin pointing to ALB. AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached to the CloudFront distribution with three rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 1, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet priority 2, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-query-inspection' priority 3 with a RegexPatternSet matching on query string values using pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|sleep\s*\(|benchmark\s*\()` with action BLOCK. Additionally, CloudFront is configured with a custom origin header 'X-CF-Secret' that the ALB listener rule requires (fixed-response 403 if absent), preventing direct ALB access.

config.origin_verification: CloudFront custom header X-CF-Secret required by ALB listener rule; direct ALB access returns 403
config.network: ALB in private subnet, only CloudFront IP ranges in SG ingress
